item.title: Hutch - PG Practice
item.description: Summary In this walkthrough, we will exploit the target by leaking a user’s password from LDAP and using the IIS web server with enabled WebDAV to upload a shell and gain code execution. We’ll then escalate by leveraging Microsoft LAPS and subsequently discover the Administrator user’s random password via LDAP. Enumeration Nmap We’ll begin with a service version nmap scan. kali@kali:~$ sudo nmap -sV 192.168.120.108 Starting Nmap 7.80 ( https://nmap.
